content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy offers a simple way for creators to sell digital products with integrated payment processing. However, it is not accessible in several countries, which limits its utility. On the other hand, platforms like Gumroad and PayPal also provide similar functionalities but often fall short of supporting creators in restricted regions. The COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack, by comparison, provides a fully customizable solution, allowing creators to establish their own digital stores with complete ownership and without reliance on restrictive platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional platforms like PayPal and Gumroad often impose geographical restrictions, and creators in countries like Nigeria or Ghana find themselves excluded. PayPal can even suspend accounts, holding funds for up to 180 days without an appeal. In contrast, COREMERCH allows creators to set up their stores using infrastructure that is agnostic of geographical limitations, making it a viable option for those previously locked out by payment giants.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed varies among platforms. Stripe typically processes payments quickly but is inaccessible in many countries. PayPal can be slow to release funds, especially during account investigations, while Lemon Squeezy's processing times depend on the payment method used. The Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments, which offers instant crypto payment verification at a low fee of 0.5%. This ensures that creators receive their funds promptly without the usual delays associated with traditional payment processors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means you own everything.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical consideration. With platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad, creators often do not have full control over their products and data. COREMERCH solutions empower creators by providing complete ownership of their stores and products after deployment. Automated delivery of digital products is seamlessly integrated into the infrastructure, allowing for instant access for buyers. This level of autonomy and efficiency simply isn't available through traditional platforms that impose ongoing fees and limitations.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you are in a restricted region and need immediate access to payment processing, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. It can be deployed in just 48 hours, and offers extensive features that ensure stability and performance. For those looking for a more comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit provides all necessary tools to establish a robust online store. Assessing your product range and target audience will guide you to the best option.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No subscriptions or dependencies on platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
